name: hushreply
description: Free, open-source ManyChat alternative: auto-DM anyone who comments a keyword on your Instagram or Facebook posts. Self-hosted on Cloudflare Workers' free tier.

STATE.description: Stores dedupe claims, per-person cooldowns and refreshed Instagram tokens. Created for you; the default name is fine.

META_APP_SECRET.description: Your Meta app's secret: [developers.facebook.com/apps](https://developers.facebook.com/apps) → your app → **App settings → Basic → App secret**.

IG_APP_SECRET.description: The **Instagram** app secret, a different value from the one above: your app → **Instagram → API setup with Instagram login**. Instagram webhooks are signed with it. Leave blank if you only use Facebook.

VERIFY_TOKEN.description: Any random string, e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 16`. You paste the same value into Meta's webhook settings.

IG_USER_ID.description: Optional. Your Instagram professional account id (digits only). Leave blank to skip Instagram.

IG_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Optional. The Instagram access token generated on the same **API setup with Instagram login** page. Refreshed daily by the Worker.

FB_PAGE_ID.description: Optional. Your Facebook Page id (digits only). Leave blank to skip Facebook.

FB_PAGE_TOKEN.description: Optional. A never-expiring Page access token. See the [setup guide](https://github.com/lakpriya1s/hushreply/blob/main/docs/setup.md#facebook-page-token).

DRY_RUN.description: Keep `true` until a test comment shows a match in the logs. Then set it to `false` in `wrangler.toml` and commit to start sending.

CONTACT_EMAIL.description: Shown on the `/privacy`, `/terms` and `/data-deletion` pages Meta asks for. Use a real inbox.

APP_NAME.description: Your app or brand name, shown on the legal pages.

LEGAL_NAME.description: Optional. The person or company legally responsible, if different from the app name.

IG_LOGIN_MODE.description: `instagram` (Instagram Login, the default) or `facebook` (Instagram via a Facebook Page).

GRAPH_VERSION.description: Meta Graph API version. Leave as is.
